title: Our new flat
instructions: Tim yeni dairesini eski evleriyle karşılaştırıyor. Uzun bir metin; eski ve yeni evi karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: tim
script.text: Last month, my wife and I moved to a new flat.

script.speaker: tim
script.text: Our old house was outside the city. It had a big garden, but it was very old and cold.

script.speaker: tim
script.text: The new flat is in the city centre, on the third floor.

script.speaker: tim
script.text: It has two bedrooms, a living room and a small kitchen. There isn't a garden, but there is a big balcony.

script.speaker: tim
script.text: From the balcony, we can see the river.

script.speaker: tim
script.text: The best thing is that I can walk to work now. Before, I drove for an hour every day.

script.speaker: tim
script.text: The bad thing is the noise. The street is very busy at night.

script.speaker: tim
script.text: My wife wants a cat, but cats are not allowed in the building.

questions.evidence: Our old house was outside the city.

questions.prompt: What does the new flat have?
questions.feedback: Bahçe yok ama büyük bir balkon var. Büyük bahçe eski evdeydi.

questions.prompt: How does Tim go to work now?
questions.feedback: Artık işe yürüyerek gidiyor; önceden bir saat araba sürüyordu.
questions.evidence: I can walk to work now.

questions.prompt: What is the bad thing about the new flat?
questions.feedback: Kötü yanı gürültü; sokak geceleri çok kalabalık.
questions.evidence: The bad thing is the noise.

questions.prompt: Why can't they have a cat?
options: Cats are not allowed in the building.
questions.evidence: cats are not allowed in the building.
